intro.h2: Design help, cabinets and stone from one team
paragraphs: MK Stones and Cabinets handles kitchen remodeling in Wellington, FL, from the first design talk to the final countertop. Karolina works with you on the layout, the cabinets and the stone, and her crew does the installation.

One client is an architect who has designed and built seven kitchens on his own. This time he hired Karolina for a kitchen in his daughter's home. Our crew carefully removed the 10 year old granite tops, took out the 30 year old cabinets, installed new ones and reinstalled the countertops. He called the work perfect. Other clients praise how quickly Karolina answers their questions.

services.h2: Our kitchen and bath services in Wellington

items.name: Kitchen design and remodeling
items.blurb: Karolina plans the kitchen with you and makes sure everyone in the family is happy with it before work starts. One client says she efficiently helped with the design and worked carefully to get his daughter's approval. Her crew then handles the removal and installation.

image.alt: Modern kitchen with white base cabinets, floating shelves, stainless range and a long light countertop

items.name: Granite and stone countertops
items.blurb: Stone is in our name. We help you pick the stone that suits your needs and style, and our crew installs it. A client with many questions and high expectations says the countertops in her house came out exactly to her liking.

image.alt: White stone countertop with soft gray veining and an undermount sink cutout

items.name: New kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Old cabinets out, new cabinets in. For one family our crew removed and disposed of 30 year old cabinets, installed new gray shaker cabinets and coordinated the countertop work, so the whole kitchen came together as one project.

image.alt: Gray shaker kitchen cabinets with dark granite countertops and a stainless dishwasher

items.name: Keep your granite, replace your cabinets
items.blurb: If your countertops are still good but the cabinets are worn out, we can lift the granite, replace the cabinets underneath and reinstall the same tops. We did exactly that for an architect's daughter: the 10 year old granite stayed and the 30 year old cabinets went.

image.alt: Gray shaker cabinets with a dark granite countertop and granite backsplash

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Our team also remodels bathrooms, often together with the kitchen. One couple redid their kitchen and bathrooms with Karolina and says her installation crew was professional, worked with precision and did a phenomenal job cleaning up when the work was finished.

about.text: MK Stones and Cabinets is a kitchen remodeler with an office at 3132 Fortune Way in Wellington, Florida. Karolina leads the work: she meets you, helps with the design and the choice of stone and cabinets, and coordinates the crew that installs them. Clients describe her courtesy, professionalism, kindness and determination, and one couple called her a rare find. Our 5.0 Google rating comes from jobs that range from countertops alone to full kitchen and bathroom remodels. One architect client says he is very happy to refer us.

steps.title: Meet Karolina
steps.text: Call (561) 452-3551 and talk through your kitchen or bathroom. Karolina answers questions quickly and helps you see what is possible.

steps.title: Design and approval
steps.text: We work out the design with you and anyone else who needs to sign off, like the client whose daughter approved the plan before work began.

steps.title: Pick your stone
steps.text: We help you choose the slabs and cabinets that suit your needs and style, so the countertops come out exactly to your liking.

steps.title: Remove and install
steps.text: The crew removes old tops and cabinets carefully, disposes of what goes, installs the new cabinets and sets the countertops with precision.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: When the work is done, our crew cleans up. Clients say the installers were respectful of their home and left it clean.

testimonials.h2: What clients say about Karolina and the crew

items.name: Peter W.
items.text: Karolina and her team did an excellent job! Please take note I’m an architect and on my own I’ve designed and built my kitchen, my son’s and 5 others. This time I couldn’t, so we hired Karolina. She efficiently helped us with the design, worked carefully to obtain my daughter’s approval, and coordinated her team to carefully remove the 10 year old granite top, dispose the 30 year old cabinets, install new one, then successfully reinstall the counter tops. Their work was perfect, and we are very happy to refer them to you!

items.name: Ashley W.
items.text: 10* quality, with people who take great pride in their business and quality of craftsmanship. I am an exhausting client with many questions and high expectations; Karolina was always available with immediate response times and helpful insight to make the countertops in our house exactly to our liking. Even the people who came to install the stone were absolutely delightful and respectful to our home - end to end great service. Highly recommend!

items.name: Judith D.
items.text:
My husband and I had the privilege of working with Karolina when we were redoing our kitchen and bathrooms. From the moment we met Karolina she demonstrated courtesy, and professionalism. As the project progressed Karolina remained steadfast with prompt responses and determination to exceed our expectations. She did not falter. Not once. Her unmatched level of skill and talent coupled with her kindness and thoughtfulness make Karolina a rare find. Her installation crew was also professional, worked with precision and even did a phenomenal job cleaning up after the job was done!
We highly recommend Karolina and her crew at MK Stones And Cabinets for kitchen and bathroom remodeling.

service_area.text: Our office is at 3132 Fortune Way d9 in Wellington, Florida, and Wellington is home base for our kitchen, cabinet and countertop work. If you live outside Wellington and want to know whether we can take on your project, call (561) 452-3551 during office hours, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM, and Karolina will let you know.

items.q: Can you replace my cabinets but keep my granite countertops?
items.a: Yes, when the stone is in good shape. For one family we carefully removed their 10 year old granite tops, took out and disposed of the 30 year old cabinets, installed new cabinets and then reinstalled the original countertops. The client, an architect, called the work perfect.

items.q: Do you help with kitchen design?
items.a: Yes. Karolina helps with the design and with picking stones and cabinets that suit your needs and style. One client said she efficiently helped with the design and worked carefully to get his daughter's approval before the crew started on the kitchen.

Yes. We remodel kitchens and bathrooms. One couple redid their kitchen and bathrooms with Karolina and recommends MK Stones and Cabinets for both, praising the installation crew's precision and the cleanup at the end. Call (561) 452-3551 to talk through your bathroom.

items.q: Where is your office and when are you open?
items.a: Our office is at 3132 Fortune Way d9, Wellington, FL 33414. We are open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM and closed on weekends. Call (561) 452-3551 during those hours to talk about your project or set up a time to meet.

items.q: How quickly will I hear back?
items.a: Fast responses are one of the things clients mention most. One describes Karolina as always available with immediate response times, even for a client with many questions and high expectations. Another praises her prompt responses throughout the project. Call (561) 452-3551 on a weekday.

final_cta.text: Call Karolina to talk about cabinets, stone and design.
